intro: The Brainwashed Noble is an elusive, captive aristocrat found deep within the subterranean caverns outside the Deadmines in Westfall. Stripped of his autonomy through magical manipulation, he serves the Defias Brotherhood alongside undead minions rather than walking the grand halls of Stormwind.

p: Wandering the murky, bone-littered passages leading into the Deadmines, the Brainwashed Noble presents a jarring contrast to the desperate bandits and rotting corpses that surround him. Clad in remnants of highborn finery, he was almost certainly a sitting member or scion of Stormwind's House of Nobles before falling into Edwin VanCleef's hands. Rather than ransom him for gold, the Defias have bent his mind with enchantments, turning a member of the ruling class into a spellcasting guard for their secret sanctuary. His tragic presence speaks volumes about the lengths the Brotherhood will go to inflict revenge upon the peers who refused to pay them.
